source.provenance: Recovered byte-for-byte from cached historical Git ref; packaged VCS metadata, not an independently fetched/authenticated Git revision.

target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu; 64-bit usize. Fresh platform, not relabelled historical macOS evidence.
required_domain: Every u64 and every initialized exclusive &mut [u8;10], arbitrary previous bytes; no requires, no numerical or zero-buffer restriction.
required_property: Returned prefix length 1..=10; byte j = floor(number/128^j)%128 + (128 iff j+1<length); number<128^length; length>1 implies number>=128^(length-1); no panic/failed debug assertion.
suffix_and_borrow: Untouched suffix and returned-prefix alias tested natively only if native checks run. No formal suffix/alias claim in the canonical goal; Rust checks lifetimes/exclusivity. No promise to formalize suffix/borrow as part of this experiment.
source_fidelity: ordinary.rs retains exact selected macro and wrapper bodies; adapted-* inserts only existing verus_exec_expr! around the macro expansion; no iterator/indexing rewrite.
protocol: Build own matching compiler/macros/verified-vstd; cold then warm separate processes for each ordinary/inferred, plain/--infer-goals, unadapted/adapted fixture. Record actual first blockers only. If full property blocked, isolate with source-faithful diagnostics and semantic controls, propose smallest concrete extension. No engine edits before freeze. All verification uses --no-cheating; no application external_body/assume/admit, no bypass.
